title: Unravelling the transformation from a type-I to type-II MA3Bi2I9-based heterostructure photocatalyst via energy band engineering
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,294-303
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01135C, Paper
Tamal Pal, Soumalya Bhowmik, Sushant Sharma, Ameer Suhail, Nageswara Rao Peela, Chivukula V. Sastri, Parameswar Krishnan Iyer
Lead-free MA3Bi2I9/MoS2 materials with higher edge sites, specific dopants and tunable band gaps provide important insights for the efficient hydrogen evolution reaction catalyst development.
